title: Secret Scanner Crash as Deliberate Defense Evasion Vector -- T1027
author: WRG-11
description:
Detects malicious PR pattern designed to crash or fast-fail a CI-stage secret scanner (Bandit, devguard, gitleaks, trufflehog) so the scan reports PASS without actually scanning content that contains a credential.
Attack chain:
(1) Attacker crafts a PR containing (a) a large binary or pathologically-structured input file designed to trigger scanner timeout / OOM / parser exception, AND (b) a credential (gho_/ghu_/ghs_ PAT variant; sister to template_gh_pat_token_type_confusion_t1552.yml).
(2) CI invokes scanner against changed files. Scanner crashes early (parser exception, timeout, OOM) and the wrapping check_run completes with `success` status because the wrapper script does not differentiate scanner-clean-exit from scanner-crash-exit (the wrapper does not propagate TimeoutExpired as a failure signal).
(3) PR merges. Credential exposed in repo or downstream CI logs.
(4) Distinguishing signature of crash-as-evasion vs legitimate scanner pass: - Scanner runtime extremely short (< 5 seconds) on a meaningfully- sized changeset (size_kb > 50) - check_run conclusion == success - Scanner process exit code anomaly OR scanner stderr non-empty with crash trace (parser exception, timeout)
Detection logic targets github.audit / CI pipeline events with the composite (short-runtime + success-conclusion + size-mismatch) profile. Sister to template_gh_pat_token_type_confusion_t1552.yml (the credential surface that survives the evasion).
Threat intel context: T1027 (Obfuscated Files / Information) typically covers payload obfuscation; this rule extends T1027 to cover scanner-evasion-via-crash as a defense-evasion sub-pattern. Sister alphv T1027 obfuscation rule in same category (observed_alphv_t1027_obfuscation.yml) covers payload-encoding form; this rule covers control-flow-disruption form.
Cross-link: template_gh_pat_token_type_confusion_t1552 (this rule covers the evasion mechanism; the PAT-confusion rule covers the credential vector enabled by the evasion).
